business_definition: Failed terminal settlement attempts divided by failed plus settled terminal settlement attempts. Pending and authorized payments are excluded.
expression: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN source.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN source.status IN ('FAILED', 'SETTLED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
